overview: AI Image Studio is a creative image generation app powered by Hugging Face's free AI models. Build detailed prompts with controls for body type, clothing styles (including beachwear, swimwear, bikini), emotions with intensity levels, camera settings, lighting presets (including beach/tropical), and more. Features automatic fallback between free models when servers are busy.
features: Hugging Face API integration with FLUX.1-schnell as default model
Comprehensive prompt generator with 15+ control categories
Clothing styles including beachwear, swimwear, bikini, sarong, sun dress
Beach and tropical lighting and environment presets
Emotions with 3 intensity levels (subtle, moderate, intense)
Automatic model fallback on server overload (503 errors)
512x512 JPEG output optimized for Internet Computer limits
Prompt history and reusable preset management
Dark mode design with rose-gold and teal accents
